profile.headline: Software Engineer at ClearBalance
profile.summary: My name is Eric Romero. My mission is to obtain a position within an organization where my experience and determination for success may be utilized for company growth and development.  I have graduated from Texas A&M University - Corpus Christi with a Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science with a concentration in Cyber Security.  I have great time management skills and can work you into my schedule. I am a recent hire at ClearBalance and in addition to these responsibilities, I participated in several extracurricular activities throughout my college career including the Sigma Phi Epsilon Fraternity, the Computer Science club, 7-day Film Festival, and Undergraduate Image Processing Research. I’m a very busy individual and I utilize my resources to the best of my ability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
ClearBalance HealthCare offers consumer-friendly patient financing and patient pay management solutions to reduce bad debt, accelerate cash flow and increase patient loyalty. My responsibilities include maintaining and upgrading existing software systems and creating new software solutions to meet evolving business needs.

CSR Call Queue
Description -A MicroService for queuing outbound calls to customers. 
Technologies -Stateless MicroService, .NET CORE, Rest web services, SQL Server
Benefit -Allows call center representatives to more easily and efficiently make outbound calls to customers.

Communications Service
Description - A Microservice to handle all outgoing email and text messages
Technologies - Stateful MicroService, ASP.NET Windows Service, Plivo, MailGun
Benefit -Consolidates all external communications to a single place and removes 3rd party texting and email vendor dependencies from core business functionality.

Aging Trial Balance Importer
Description-A generic importer to be used by hospitals to import patient accounts and balances.
Technologies-ASP.NET MVC, Rest web services, SSIS, SQL Server 
Benefit -Allows hospital users to more easily import accounts in real-time without data entry. 

Online Loan Acceptance & Patient Self Enrollment
Description -Platform to allow for the acceptance of disclosures online.
Technologies -ASP.NET MVC, SQL Server, SSRS
Benefit -Increased customer convenience, saving the cost associated with printing and posting physical disclosure documents. 

Customer Identification Program (CIP) Service
Description -A service that allows verifiability of the identity of individuals.
Technologies -ASP.NET MVC, SQL Server, SSRS, Equifax, IDology
Benefit -Increased customer convenience by automating the validation of their identity.

honors.title: Student Employee of the Year Runner-Up 2016
honors.description: I routinely generate ideas and initiate action to solve problems.  For example, one aspect of my job involves overseeing customer tickets which are escalated from our help desk team.  At various times of the year, such as the beginning of the Fall semester, we experience a very high volume of requests which are handled across our student employee team and full-time staff.  I recognized that we did not have an easy way to identify where tickets might be piling up.  I took the initiative to work with the application administrator of our customer ticketing system and created custom reports for our team which display graphs of how many tickets we have and I organized the report by the type of ticket and who is assigned to the ticket.  This enhancement to our operations has also led to a better user experience and has helped to minimize resolution time of our tickets.  I also continued to improve this idea by implementing an automated process to send out these reports daily.
honors.issuer: Issued by Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi · Apr 2016

projects.title: The Mobile Fitness Network
projects.description: The purpose of the project is to create The Mobile Fitness Network (MFN).  Similar to the application Uber, the MFN is a web app that allows users to find personal trainers and create training sessions with these trainers at the user’s home, place of business, or an agreed upon workout location. The MFN can be accessed on a computer’s web browser or a mobile phone’s web browser.

projects.title: The Use of Residual Heat and Image Processing to Capture PINs
projects.description: Developed an algorithm that can decipher a PIN from the thermal image of a recently used access point, like an ATM.
